title: [TDD-RED] Vitest causes machine freeze - optimize memory/CPU usage
description:
## Problem
Running vitest tests causes machine to freeze due to excessive memory and CPU consumption.

## TDD Phases

### RED Phase
- [ ] Create benchmark test that measures memory usage during test runs
- [ ] Document current memory/CPU baseline metrics
- [ ] Identify tests that cause memory spikes

### GREEN Phase  
- [ ] Configure vitest with memory-efficient settings:
  - Set `poolOptions.threads.maxThreads` to limit parallelism
  - Set `poolOptions.threads.minThreads: 1`
  - Consider `pool: 'forks'` instead of threads
  - Set `maxConcurrency` to limit concurrent tests
  - Enable `isolate: false` for faster runs (with caution)
- [ ] Add `--no-file-parallelism` flag for CI
- [ ] Configure memory limits in vitest.config.ts

### REFACTOR Phase
- [ ] Split test suites into smaller chunks
- [ ] Add test:light script for development
- [ ] Document recommended test running practices

## Acceptance Criteria
- Tests run without freezing machine
- Memory usage stays under 4GB
- CPU usage doesn't spike to 100% sustained

## Files to Modify
- packages/shadmin/vitest.config.ts
- packages/shadmin/package.json (scripts)
